audience: online sellers and warehouse teams that manage orders, stock and returns in ChannelDock

useCases.title: Find orders that still need a shipment
useCases.text: List orders from a recent time window and check the shipments that belong to them. Search one order by its number.

useCases.title: Check stock levels for a product
useCases.text: Look up products by EAN or SKU and read their stock, prices and dimensions. See which stock locations and sections hold the stock.

useCases.title: Correct the stock or price of a product
useCases.text: Look up the product, then set its corrected stock, price, title or EAN by product id. Other fields stay as they are.

useCases.title: Add a note to an order log
useCases.text: Read the activity log of an order, then add a manual note, such as where the order was picked. The note changes no order data.

useCases.title: Review open returns and internal tasks
useCases.text: List customer returns with their order, handling status and comments. List the internal tasks, such as a stock count, with their status.
